metadata.runtime_reference_overlap_rationale: Shares words with the examples, not code: board, existing, and selected come from the audit message "existing board selected", and options is a parameter name the gift-wrap and workspace examples also use. The gift-wrap example checks presence too, but the enum constant it returns depends on the Optional<Boolean> value; no example picks an enum constant from presence alone or keeps an audit branch. SKILL.md workflow step 1 shows the same rule with an if/else that assigns one of two Duration constants; its map(p -> PROXY_TIMEOUT).orElse(DIRECT_TIMEOUT) has the shape of this answer, as any example of the rule would.
